profile.headline: Engineer @ Salesforce
profile.summary:
Hi I am currently working as a Lead Software Engineer at Salesforce in the Terraform team, specializing in using Terraform, AWS, and Kubernetes to scale modern cloud infrastructure.

Prior to my current role, I have a background in full-stack development with the MERN (Mongo-Express-React-Node.js) stack, full-stack web development with Java Spring.

Outside of work, my interests include surfing, gaming, running, music, and the outdoors!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Currently working in the Terraform Team.
positions.insights: PKI, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +9 skills

positions.title: Sofware Developer
positions.description:
- Maintained enterprise web application, responsible for full-stack maintenance of platform including database management (Oracle SQL), front-end development (JSP), and back-end framework development (Java Struts/ Spring)
- Transcribed and optimized 50+ legacy and new SQL scripts to adapt database to new modules and updated versions of the application
- Took the responsibility of test lead for platform, creating along with managing 20+ scenarios for web applications
- Modularized authentication security system for dynamic use across all web projects, adding additional layer of security for all users and projects

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a Price Advisor generator using React, which was utilized across major automotive companies, acquiring 80+ unique user hits per second during launch 
- Took initiative to patch 40+ bugzilla tickets regarding interface corrections and api remapping within three sprints, reducing number of bugs by 30% before launch
- Spearheaded consolidation and api handling for exception and error modules, leading test-driven agile design and development amongst 10 team members in agile scrum environment
- Created new demo page utilizing React Redux to be used by entire company to test various modules

positions.title: Python Lab Tutor
positions.description:
- Aided in the progressment of students from intermediate to advanced mastery of their first language across two quarters of curriculum
- Collaborated with other tutors to create new study material outlining each subject to aid 300+ students per quarter
